scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run ruff format . && uv run shfmt -w -i 2 scripts/*.sh && taplo fmt pyproject.toml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run shfmt -d -i 2 scripts/*.sh && taplo fmt --check pyproject.toml
scripts.check:docs: uv run python scripts/check_docs.py && uv run python scripts/notes_guard.py --root . && uv run python scripts/check_archive.py
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint:js && npm run lint:md && uv run ruff check . && uv run shellcheck scripts/*.sh && uv run actionlint && npm run check:docs && uv run python -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests && npm test && npm run build
